title: Line Boil — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea to system
scenes.purpose: Show an idea (bulb) branching into a connected network, all drawn in a controlled three-drawing line boil on cool newsprint.
visuals: Cool newsprint paper #DDE5E8 with static seeded grain
Blue-black ink #1E2B33 Rough.js line art cycling drawings A/B/C on twos
Bulb, filament, base and light rays at left
Seven wires and five hachure-filled nodes

beats.development: Headline fades up; bulb glass sketches in, then filament, base and light rays: the idea appears.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system
Line boil: 3 drawings, A → B → C, each held 2 frames

beats.development: Two wires grow from the bulb; nodes 1 and 2 pop in as they arrive, then the second wire tier reaches toward nodes 3 and 4.
Nodes 3 and 4 land; the cross-link and final wires close the loop into node 5. The system is complete at 2.52 s.
Settled hold: the drawing keeps boiling in place while the full composition reads.

findings: Copy is visible from about 0.45 s and stays fixed after that, so it has more than 2.5 s of legible exposure.
Each node pop starts as its wire arrives, so the eye travels left to right.
justifiedHolds: 2.55–3.0 s: final hold so the finished system can be read; the boil keeps the line art alive without moving its silhouette.

notes: No source-frame matches were available, and no recipes were supplied.
